facts.fact: CLIQ Marketing Content offers construction companies a free consultation with its director as the way to get started with its Google Ads service.
facts.quote: All it takes to get started is a free consultation with our director.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, co-director Tim Buttery has over five years of experience working with brands such as BUPA and Coca-Cola.
facts.quote: Tim brings over five years of experience working with brands like BUPA and Coca-Cola

facts.fact: The vendor states that CLIQ Marketing Content is led by co-directors Tim and Esther Buttery.
facts.quote: Led by co-directors Tim and Esther Buttery, CLIQ combines marketing expertise with operational precision.

facts.fact: The vendor describes its Google Ads management for construction companies as three named stages: Asset Creation, Campaign Structuring, and Review & Optimisation.
